zh.title: 点过批准，AI 换个会话还能继续吗？
zh.summary: 一次明确的操作已获批准，Agent 恢复到新会话后却再次被要求审批。CodeFlowMu 当前源码的两层对照，让‘授权跟随谁’成为可检验的问题。

en.title: Approved once. Can the AI resume in a new session?
en.summary: An exact operation was approved, but a resumed Agent was asked to seek approval again. A two-layer CodeFlowMu comparison makes the ownership of an approval a testable question.
